request.subject: PORTRAIT:MARTIAN:BATTLESHIP

layers.text: Rebuild it as a big retro sci-fi hover-cruiser: the wooden hull becomes smooth rounded polished chrome and silver-white metal shaded soft blue-grey, with a dark gunmetal underside; the masts and sails are removed; a tall chrome bridge tower under a clear pale glass dome; chrome ray turrets with glowing hot magenta tips; small glowing hot magenta lights. Keep the size, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
